==Trivia==

* ''Diana'' derives from {{w|Proto-Indo-European language|PIE}} root {{w|Dyeus|''*dyew-''}} "to shine".
** She shares her name with [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Diana_(mythology) Diana]. Roman goddess of the Moon.<ref>[https://www.reddit.com/r/leagueoflegends/comments/1dogz3/champion_names_and_their_origins/c9sgr3p/ IronStylus on champion names]</ref>
*Diana's concept artist [[Michael 'IronStylus' Maurino]] has confirmed that Diana was intended to be lesbian when she was first created.<ref>[https://x.com/Iron_Stylus/status/850598651281907713 IronStylus on Diana's sexuality]</ref> Her forbidden relationship with [[Leona]] was later canonized in the short story [https://universe.leagueoflegends.com/en_US/story/rise-with-me/ "Rise with Me"].
* Diana is the first champion to feature animations for when affected by both [[crowd control]] and [[movement speed]] [[buff]]s.
* {{ais|Moonfall|Diana}} indicator above Diana references the {{w|Lunar phase}}.<ref>[https://twitter.com/Beardilocks/status/1200111247657558017 Moonfall indicator]</ref>
** 1 enemy: New moon
** 2 enemies: Waning crescent
** 3 enemies: Last quarter
** 4 enemies: Waning gibbous
** 5 enemies: Full moon
* A functional replica of {{cci|Moonfall old.png||Crescent Moonblade}} was crafted in an episode of YouTube series [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kz-0nfkVegg Man At Arms: Reforged].
** There are also videos where the following are crafted:
*** {{cai|Preparation|Katarina|Daggers}} ([https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Lq-h3KkF_bY functional])
*** {{cai|Zenith Blade|Leona}} ([https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yEwne-IEG9s functional])
*** {{cai|Highlander|Master Yi|'Highlander' Ring Sword}} ([https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-EqnHVY1uEo functional])
*** {{cai|Hammer Shock|Poppy|Hammer of Orlon}} ([https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eqCmrn-80sQ functional])
*** {{cai|Steel Tempest|Yasuo|'Last Breath' Sword}} ([https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W_7vdfoJApQ functional])
*** {{cai|Short Fuse|Ziggs|Hexplosive Bomb}} ([https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3I6MK1SV1Lk prop])

{{Patch box|Azir}}

==Trivia==
* Azir is the first champion to have his first ability point restricted to a single one ({{ai|Arise!|Azir}}) since it's required for the other two ({{ai|Conquering Sands|Azir}} and {{ai|Shifting Sands|Azir}}) to function.
** He is also the second champion to have basic abilities that cannot be ranked up at level 1, the others being {{ci|Zilean}}, {{ci|Shen}} (reworked) and {{ci|Xayah}}.
* {{ai|Shurima's Legacy|Azir}} may be referencing the Egyptian solar disc god {{w|Aten}}<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/0/http://boards.na.leagueoflegends.com/en/c/gameplay-balance/9f9inmau-azir-qa-art-sound?comment=00030001 Azir art discussion 1]</ref> (depicted as a sphere emanating rays of light each ending with a hand) and titular god of the short-lived monotheistic religion imposed by Pharaoh {{w|Akhenaten}}. His son {{w|Tutankhamun}} later restored the polytheistic religion.
* Azir's dance references [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LeiFF0gvqcc Remember The Time] by {{w|Michael Jackson}}.
** A side-by-side comparison can be seen [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mg9cRCTUJKg here].
** If Azir {{ai|Arise!|Azir|summons}} Sand Soldiers and then dances, they will follow him and dance all in sync.
*** His soldiers will keep dancing in Azir's stead if the player types '/dance' while Azir is {{si|Recall|recalling}}.
*** If enemies cannot see Azir while he dances, his soldiers will not appear to dance to them.

|abilities = 
;Reborn
''Void Remora'' are summoned by all lane minions that are killed while '''Bel'Veth''' is within {{tt|1000|Pending for test}} units of them including allied ones. They emerge from the Void after {{fd|0.75}} seconds of the minion dying. Each type of minion killed spawns a certain number of ''Void Remora'':
* {{ui|Blue Melee Minion|link=Melee minion|Melee minions}} - 1 Melee
* {{ui|Blue Caster Minion|link=Caster minion|Caster minions}} - 1 Ranged
* {{ui|Blue Siege Minion|link=Siege minion|Siege minions}} - 1 Melee and 1 Ranged
* {{ui|Blue Super Minion|link=Super minion|Super minions}} - 2 Melee and 2 Ranged

;Replicate
''Void Remora'' are spawned with the stats that a minion would have at the time of the match.

;Serve
''Void Remora'' automatically move down the lane in which they were spawned in and attack any enemy within their path. '''Bel'Veth''' receives the credit for any unit the ''Void Remora'' kill.

=== General ===
* ''Void Remora'' are special cased to have most of the same behaviors and interactions as regular lane minions.
** They can be empowered by the {{bi|Hand of Baron}}.
*** Bonus {{as|{{sti|attack range}}}} and {{as|{{sti|attack damage}}}} is not granted, but the haste and size is.
** Nearby allied {{ui|Blue Super Minion|link=Super minion|Super minions}} will grant them the effects of {{ii|Super Mech Power Field}}.
** They have equal targeting priority to {{tip|turret|turrets}} as minions.
** They do not have {{tip|turret}} damage modifiers ({{ii|Gusto}} and {{ii|Phreakish Gusto}}) nor are treated as minions to {{nie|Spoils of War}}.
* ''Void Remora'' have 400 '''base''' movement speed and 150 '''bonus''' movement speed from both scaling and push bonuses. This equates to 550 '''total''' movement speed that is soft capped to 505.

==Trivia==
* Ambessa is the second champion to be revealed for {{tip|League of Legends}}, {{tip|Wild Rift}}, and {{tip|Legends of Runeterra}} around the same time, after {{ci|Akshan}}.
** At the time, Ambessa was the only champion that was revealed to be announced in all games within the {{tip|League of Legends}} {{tt|IP|Intellectual Property}}, including {{tip|Teamfight Tactics}}.
* {{Champion without ability power ratio|Ambessa}}
* Ambessa is the first {{fi|Ionia|non-Ionian}} champion to use {{tip|energy}}.
* With {{ci|Mel}}'s release, Ambessa is the first female champion to be a mother of another champion.
** There are playable champions which are mothers, but not of other playable champions, such as {{ci|Rek'Sai}}.
** There are also champions which have known mothers, such as {{ci|Smolder}} and {{ci|Nunu}}, but their mothers are not playable champions themselves.
* Her buff flavor text reads:
** ''Medarda Maxim'' ({{ai|Drakehound's Step|Ambessa}} stacks): ''"Don't pity the meek" — Medarda Family Motto''
** ''D I S R E S P E C T'' ({{ai|Sundering Slam|Ambessa}} ready): ''"Find out what it means to me." — Ambessa Medarda''
** ''Antici—'' ({{ai|Repudiation|Ambessa}} steadying): ''—pation''
***This is a reference to Dr. Frank-N-Furter's [https://youtu.be/OqOEnbXmnGc?si=1ObjKNtdWMbag42k&t=7 iconic line] in ''{{w|The Rocky Horror Picture Show}}'' comedy horror movie. 
** ''Unfazed'' ({{ai|Repudiation|Ambessa}} shield): ''"Some say the best defense is a good offense. Why pick when I have both." — Ambessa Medarda''
** ''Pathetic'' ({{ai|Lacerate|Ambessa}} slow): ''"You're a third rate fighter with fourth rate technique." — Ambessa Medarda'' [sic]
*** This is a reference to [https://yugipedia.com/wiki/Seto_Kaiba Seto Kaiba's] insult to [https://yugipedia.com/wiki/Joey_Wheeler Joey Wheeler] in the ''{{w|Yu-Gi-Oh}}'' anime.
** ''Always Win Your Battles'' ({{ai|Public Execution|Ambessa}} successful cast): ''"Defeat earns you nothing, I simply win." — Ambessa Medarda''
** ''Some Advice'' ({{ai|Public Execution|Ambessa}} suppression): ''"Don't be sorry, be better." — Ambessa Medarda''
*** This is similar to Kratos' [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mwf3EPnusVQ quote] in ''{{w|God of War (2018 video game)|God of War (2018)}}'' video game. (''Do not be sorry, be better.'')
** Killing an enemy champion grants her a cosmetic buff that reads: ''"For you, the day the Medardas graced your village was the most important day of your life. But for me, it was Tuesday."''
*** This [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GlhOUyy4wbs quotes] M. Bison in ''{{w|Street Fighter (1994)|Street Fighter}}'', referring to himself instead.
** Being killed by an enemy {{ci|Mel}} grants her the ''Took Long Enough'' cosmetic buff that reads: ''Mel has killed Ambessa. 'This is a new feeling. Pride in someone else. Finally.' - Ambessa Medarda''
*** This is a reference to DragonBall Z Abridged's [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dSJlqrnC6bE Vegeta's Unyielding Rage].
